Two independent allied economies escort three sequential two-truck convoys. Choose the northern or southern route at each checkpoint. Either commander can Hold; after a manual hold both must approve Advance. The visible countdown protects route decisions. A completed convoy unlocks one forward repair position for each owner, not free combat reinforcements. At least one truck from each convoy must arrive.
All three convoys have arrived. Independent command and shared route decisions kept the corridor operating.
Convoy one is ready. Approve Advance, or Hold while an escort clears the chosen branch.
variants.display_caption: CONVOY CONTROL: Convoy one is ready. Approve Advance, or Hold while an escort clears the chosen branch.
